trust_boundary_review.finding: Existing FacadeQuantityTableCommand.Read requires selection.Ok, rows, nonempty Fingerprint and result.ok before Build. Common reader and validation are unchanged. Direct DTO probes prove validation/presentation, not native CAD freshness.
Exact role bracket and origin generated:ATFRAME:brackets; ID prefix belongs to passport.source_run_id. No use of report.run_id for physical ownership.

Distinct nonempty zone_ids; fallback zone_id only when none. Exactly one canonical zone must belong to selected report/passport scope. A true multi-zone element is excluded; duplicate identical zone values remain one zone.

Only currently surviving physical elements enter eligibility. Repeated physical IDs emit one diagnostic. Retained report IDs may differ from source_run_id. All eligible selected candidate links are read before presentation member deduplication.

Only schema aframe_connection_passport/1 with inventory_only contributes. Unavailable, absent legacy/manual passports, manual origin, foreign source run and unselected zones do not establish an absence claim. Unknown remains unknown.

No support assignment, new rail row, fixed/sliding type, splice continuity, gravity distribution or strength is inferred. Source DTOs remain unchanged. Diagnostics do not remove physical quantities or pick catalogue products.

Additional element/run/zone indexes, passport-scope lookups and candidate HashSet are O(E + P_scope + L), plus O(T) emitted text. The common validator forbids repeated source-run passports within one report. Existing SortedSet/output sorting is unchanged; this is not a claim that the entire existing table pipeline is strictly O(n). No new CAD read, ModelSpace scan, geometry search or engine recalculation is added.

Product UI is unchanged. Existing shared fixture checks remain; actual producer orphan fixture adds default/small/large-font lifecycle, virtual grid, text/scroll, quantities and action checks. Workflow generates the fixture and collects real native screenshots. Native execution/visual review of the new fixture awaits Windows.
